data.name: Fasiyah
data.gender_notes: Fasiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fasiyah means 'awake', 'conscious', or 'aware'. It is derived from the root word 'fasaha' which means 'to understand' or 'to make something clear'. This name is often given to a child as a reminder to stay aware of their surroundings and to always strive for knowledge and understanding. The name Fasiyah carries the meaning “Awake, Conscious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fasiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody awake, conscious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep connection to knowledge and understanding.
data.etymology: Fasiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awake, Conscious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fasiyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: فاسیہ

in_pashto.name: فاسیه
